name: Tubby Tyrone Horror
summary: Tubby Tyrone Horror is a narrative driven horror VR experience where the player is plunged right into a terrifying environment, being stalked by the frightening monster known as Tubby Tyrone. The gameplay is more than just a scarefest, featuring a proper story that is revealed as the player explores, which puts context to the places the player visits, as well as the threat the player faces. This game utilizes hand interaction in VR to its fullest, which enables players to interact with the game world physic
